Tiling¶

.. py:module:: xtrax.tiling

Tiling module for composable axis strategy selection and execution.

.. py:class:: AxisSpec(name, cardinality, batch_size, granularity=1, heterogeneous=False, dedup_eligible=False) :module: xtrax.tiling :canonical: xtrax.tiling.plan.AxisSpec

Bases: :py:class:object

Specification for a single axis to be tiled.

.. attribute:: name

  Human-readable axis name (e.g., "batch", "sequence").

.. attribute:: cardinality

  Number of elements along this axis.

.. attribute:: batch_size

  Default batch size threshold and chunk size for SafeMap.

.. attribute:: granularity

  Alignment granularity (default 1, no constraint).

.. attribute:: heterogeneous

  Whether elements have different sizes (default False).

.. attribute:: dedup_eligible

  Whether this axis is eligible for deduplication (default False).

.. py:class:: BatchPlanner(memory_estimator=None) :module: xtrax.tiling :canonical: xtrax.tiling.plan.BatchPlanner

Bases: :py:class:object

Planner that selects tiling strategies based on axis properties.

Selection rules (in priority order):

  1. dedup_eligible=True → DedupGather

  2. cardinality <= batch_size → Vmap

  3. cardinality > batch_size AND divisible → SafeMap

  4. non-divisible → SafeMap with warning (deferred-failure contract)

When memory_estimator is provided, it overrides rule 2/3 decisions to prefer SafeMap if estimated Vmap memory exceeds device limit.

.. py:method:: BatchPlanner.plan(specs) :module: xtrax.tiling

  Generate a tiling plan for the given specs.

  Pure Python — no JAX tracing. Scan is never returned.

  :type specs: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`\~collections.abc.Sequence\`\\ \\\[\:py\:class\:\`\~xtrax.tiling.plan.AxisSpec\`\]`
  :param specs: Sequence of AxisSpec objects to plan.

  :rtype: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`\~xtrax.tiling.plan.BatchPlan\``
  :returns: BatchPlan with decisions for each spec.

.. py:function:: make_axis_dispatch(strategy, fn, xs, init=None) :module: xtrax.tiling

Dispatch execution to the appropriate JAX transform based on strategy.

Exhaustively handles all four AxisStrategy variants: Vmap, SafeMap, Scan, and DedupGather. Each variant applies a different execution pattern for axis iteration.

:type strategy: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:\:py\:class\:\~xtrax.tiling.strategy.Vmap` | :py:class:`~xtrax.tiling.strategy.SafeMap` | :py:class:`~xtrax.tiling.strategy.Scan` | :py:class:`~xtrax.tiling.strategy.DedupGather`    :param strategy: The AxisStrategy to dispatch with.                     One of: Vmap | SafeMap | Scan | DedupGather.    :type fn: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type::py:class:`~collections.abc.Callable`    :param fn: Callable to apply. Unused for Scan (uses strategy.transition instead).    :type xs: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type::py:data:`~typing.Any`    :param xs: Input pytree to process.    :type init: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type::py:data:`~typing.Any`` :param init: Initial carry state. Required for Scan, ignored for others.

:rtype: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:\:py\:data\:\~typing.Any`` :returns: Result of applying the strategy, with shape and structure matching the desired execution pattern.

:raises ValueError: For Scan if init is None; for SafeMap if xs leading axis is not divisible by batch_size. :raises TypeError: If strategy is not a recognized AxisStrategy variant.
